scope: Native reference action generation with augmentation disabled and one episode/attempt; includes numeric goals, trajectories, timing, command and effect snapshots. Non-data objects captured by type name only.

summary.conclusion: Controlled same-input replay shows no action generation change for six Pick/Place calls; whole-deployment end-to-end equivalence is NOT established.

controlled_replay.method: Persist baseline PlanningContext values; ground and plan against those inputs using the current compiler and engine. No commands dispatched by the replay.

limitations: Independent simulations do not guarantee identical scene/contact observations or geometry samples even with the same seed.
Some runs fail before returning a SkillPlan or time out; these are not positive action-generation equivalence evidence.
The one-row reference sweep disables collection augmentation. It does not qualify all expansion recipes.
Some numeric snapshots differ; a same-version repeat also differs. Further investigation is required before claiming all differences are harmless.
Snapshots contain complete trajectory and command tensor values; non-data objects are represented by type name only.
